title: Strawberry Marshmallow
synopsis:
"Cute girls doing cute things in cute ways."

Everyday things make up the fabric of life, whether it's making friends, going to school, trying to make money, or celebrating a holiday. Ichigo Mashimaro is a heartwarming series that follows the daily lives of Itou Chika, her sister Nobue, and her friends Miu, Matsuri, and Ana.

episodes.title: Birthday
episodes.synopsis: Chika, Miu and Matsuri notice that it's Nobue's birthday and plan to make her a gift by themselves.

episodes.title: Ana
episodes.synopsis: After moving to Japan from England, Ana starts at the same class as Matsuri and pretends to know nothing about Japan or Japanese.

episodes.title: House Call
episodes.synopsis: Ana invites Matsuri at her place to help her study English. But much to her grief, the entire gang decides to tag along.

episodes.title: Part-time Job
episodes.synopsis: Nobue finds out she's ran out of money to buy cigarettes and tries to find a fitting part-time job. Ana, Matsuri, Chika and Miu do their best and worst to help her. Arbeit means part-time job in German.

episodes.title: Sleepover
episodes.synopsis: Miu becomes jealous over the attention Ana and Matsuri gain from Nobue.

episodes.title: Hot Summer Day
episodes.synopsis: Intense summer heat causes the girls' imagination to run wild again.

episodes.title: Beach Trip
episodes.synopsis: Miu is shooting a video documentary for school, and chooses the Itō household as her subject. In the end, Nobue takes the gang out for a beach trip.

episodes.title: Festival
episodes.synopsis: A festival episode has the gang dress up in yukatas and head out to see fireworks.

episodes.title: Growing Child
episodes.synopsis: Chika discovers she's gained a bit of weight, and, provoked by Miu, starts her own diet. It's only after a pointful remark by Nobue, that Chika's self-confidence gets restored.

episodes.title: Flower
episodes.synopsis: Many sidequests disturb the girls' trip to a distant restaurant to have cake with Nobue.

episodes.title: First Snow
episodes.synopsis: After a freezing cold autumn day, the gang pays a visit to hot baths and witnesses the first snow fall.

episodes.title: Present
episodes.synopsis: Matsuri's faith in Santa Claus makes the rest of the gang guarantee her a happy Christmas.
